characteristics.excerpt:
The device implements an internal thermal shutdown to protect itself if the junction temperature exceeds 165°C. 
The thermal shutdown forces the device to stop switching when the junction temperature exceeds the thermal 
trip threshold. After the die temperature decreases below 165°C, the device reinitiates the power-up sequence.
characteristics.not_testable_reason: no numeric limit; this fixture interpreter measures numeric characteristics
characteristics.statement: Thermal shutdown forces the device to stop switching when junction temperature exceeds 165°C; after die temperature decreases below 165°C, the device reinitiates the power-up sequence.

characteristics.statement: Enable threshold voltage is 1.25 V typical.

characteristics.excerpt:
With EN held below that voltage the device is disabled and 
switching is inhibited even if VIN is above its UVLO threshold. The IC quiescent current is reduced in this state.

characteristics.statement: With EN held below the threshold, the device is disabled and switching is inhibited even if VIN is above its UVLO threshold; if EN is increased above the threshold while VIN is above UVLO, the device becomes active and switching is enabled, initiating soft-start.

characteristics.excerpt:
When the peak inductor current is lower than pulse skip threshold, the COMP pin voltage falls to 0.5 V (typical) 
and the device enters Eco-mode . When the device is in Eco-mode, the COMP pin voltage is clamped at 0.5 V 
internally which prevents the high-side integrated MOSFET from switching.
characteristics.not_testable_reason: Eco-mode light-load entry and COMP pin 0.5 V clamp require a complete buck power stage with inductor, output capacitor, and external catch diode to establish peak inductor current below the pulse-skip threshold; allowed primitives do not include a diode and the exact power-stage values are not provided in the evidence.
characteristics.statement: When peak inductor current is lower than the pulse skip threshold, COMP pin voltage falls to 0.5 V typical and the device enters Eco-mode; COMP pin voltage is clamped at 0.5 V internally, preventing the high-side integrated MOSFET from switching.
